scripts.build: vue-tsc --noEmit && VITE_APP_MODE=student vite build --mode student && node scripts/prepare-sites.mjs
scripts.build:student: vue-tsc --noEmit && VITE_APP_MODE=student vite build --mode student --outDir dist/student
scripts.build:teacher: vue-tsc --noEmit && VITE_APP_MODE=teacher vite build --mode teacher --outDir dist/teacher
scripts.build:admin: vue-tsc --noEmit && VITE_APP_MODE=admin vite build --mode admin --outDir dist/admin
